applicabilityBasis.summary: invUSD is a decentralized crypto-collateralized CDP stablecoin minted permissionlessly against staked INV (sINV) or swapped 1:1 against USDS through an immutable Ethereum Monolith V1 Lender governed by Inverse Finance DAO. No identifiable legal issuer undertakes to issue or redeem invUSD for a fixed amount of national-currency or bank-deposit monetary value, placing it outside the GENIUS Act section 2(22) payment-stablecoin issuer framework.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-27. invUSD is a decentralized Ethereum CDP token collateralized by sINV with an on-chain USDS/sUSDS PSM rail and no designated legal issuer or fiat redemption obligation. No GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification or monthly attestation applies, and no issuerEntity or issuerDomicile is assigned. On-chain redemption mechanics are documented in Monolith protocol docs.
